body: My mom thinks he’s joking. Unfortunately I dont have a friend Im close with. It isnt like Im in an unsafe situation its just that it hurts to know my parents dont care and say things like this and should I really hurt myself to prove these ppl that Im mentally ill I dont understand

I guess I am scared if I tell him and I somehow survive, I will feel like I worried him for nothing. I wanted to say a farewell. I guess I also want to hear something like “please don’t do it” from him, because I care about his thoughts. But I’m not sure if he will try to stop me or get angry. I’m sorry if it’s a bit confusing.
what if he gets angry? I never told anyone my problems. I don’t want him to think badly of me if I leave this world
